# Kenney assets

Original GLB files and color textures from Kenney, licensed CC0. Each pack includes its original License.txt. See manifest.json for source URLs and model names.

Town layout, Korean signs, pavilion and ground surface textures are project additions.

Suburban `Textures/town-*.png` are project color variants of the original colormap (roof green changed to terracotta, slate or sage). Nature leaf and bark material colors are adjusted in code. Original models and colormap files remain intact. Asphalt, pavers, concrete and grass textures under `../town-surfaces/` were generated locally for this project, not supplied by Kenney.
